title: [seam] `page:header`'s `breadcrumb` ("Show breadcrumb", default true) draws only an empty slot — the declared capability is never honoured
body:
Seam: spec:`PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` → renderer:`PageHeaderRenderer` (`@object-ui/components`)

Filing-gate category: ② declared but not enforced, class (b). `reach:` a public door, measured: any `page:header` rendered through `SchemaRenderer`, bare or record layout.
- **Measured.** The objectui#3906 dev rendered `page:header` at PR objectui#11162's head `c79ae7497`. With the default `breadcrumb: true`, both layouts draw only an empty `div[data-page-breadcrumb-slot]` (its `textContent` is `""`), with no trail. In the control, `breadcrumb: false` removes the slot. `git grep 'breadcrumb-slot'` outside `containers.tsx` finds no code that fills it. As a control, `actions-slot` does hit tests and the CHANGELOG.
- **Confirmed at source.** PR objectui#11162's contract review (`5902367106`, ③ out-of-scope (b)) confirmed it real and pre-existing. The spec describes the key as "Show breadcrumb", `z.boolean().default(true)`.

Reader: triage first. The route is enforce-or-remove (ADR-0049): either the renderer draws the trail the key promises, or the key is retired from `PageHeaderProps`. Which one is triage's call, and the spec side of this seam is the spec lane's. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11162 (objectui#3906), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[1]` (`5902224540`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites (read at objectui `origin/main` `a8c550938`, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`)

- **The read:** `const breadcrumb = (schema?.breadcrumb ?? schema?.properties?.breadcrumb) !== false;` (`:1508`).
- **The record layout:** `{breadcrumb && ( … data-page-breadcrumb-slot … )}` (`:2343-2347`), an empty div.
- **The bare layout:** `{breadcrumb && (<div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" data-page-breadcrumb-slot />)}` (`:2379-2380`), an empty div.

The rewritten reference page `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` (PR objectui#11162) states this truthfully: the slot renders, and nothing fills it.

## Facts for the choice (not a ruling)

- A breadcrumb trail already exists elsewhere in the console. `RecordDetailView` builds a record breadcrumb title (objectui#10434 names its "breadcrumb / favourite / recent title").
- The four-axis framework's startup-stage rule defaults a declared, zero-consumer capability toward retirement, unless there is measured pull.
- `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`'s header example writes `breadcrumb: true`. That is the sibling docs card filed with this one.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (down to #10338) were grepped:
- `breadcrumb-slot` and `Show breadcrumb`: only PR objectui#11162 (the source).
- `page:header` within 300 characters of `breadcrumb`: three closed items that mention the key in other contexts (objectui#10499, #10852, #10892).

A search of objectstack for `breadcrumb PageHeaderProps` returned nothing. No card covers this.
